description: This walk along the Lincolnshire coast takes you from Skegness to Ingoldmells. It's roughly a four mile walk, heading north along the beaches and passing the golf course and Butlins complex on the way. As you head north from the iconic Skegness Pier, the route offers a fantastic blend of traditional seaside charm and refreshing coastal scenery. The wide, sandy beaches provide a firm surface for walking at low tide, while the sea wall offers a reliable path year-round. This stretch of the Lincolnshire coastline is perfect for those who enjoy the vibrant energy of the English seaside, with the sea breeze on one side and the sprawling North Shore Golf Club and the famous Butlins resort on the other.Nature lovers should keep an eye on the shoreline and the coastal dunes, which are home to a variety of hardy plant life and coastal birds. You may spot oystercatchers and sandpipers foraging in the surf, while the marram grass-covered dunes provide a habitat for local butterflies and skylarks.Arriving in Ingoldmells, you are greeted by the skyline of Fantasy Island, making this walk an excellent choice for a family day out that combines natural beauty with coastal attractions.
